metadata.description: QAEverest plugins for Cursor — AI test generation, security & performance checks.

plugins.name: qaeverest
plugins.description: An AI QA copilot in Cursor's agent: generate functional, API, UI, mobile, integration and database test cases (from a story, a spec, or your own code), run automation suites, test AI agents, and run security and performance checks. The QAEverest MCP server as tools and prompts, with skills that tell the agent when to reach for them.
